audit.whatIsWrong: Every level-chart row awards the stage to Urgot and rates the lane 2-4/10, while the packet chart is Skill/Maokai x5/Skill, the Emerald+ win rate is 62.12% over 66 games, and every whys[] string describes Maokai bullying Urgot. The page rendered two opposite answers.
audit.why: Maokai's W root at level 2 catches a melee-range Urgot who has no dash out (Disdain is a forward charge, not an escape), and Sap Magic heals the trade back. Only level 1 (one ability, no combo) and the late game (percent-max-HP legs plus the Fear Beyond Death execute) are not Maokai's.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Levels 2 through First item Maokai, 2+ items Skill; ratings flipped to match, difficulty restated as 4.5/10.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Maokai at levels 2-3 (full W-Q-Sap pattern), level 6 (Nature's Grasp walls the Disdain engage), first item; Urgot at Disdain online, 6, and first item, with his late scaling reclaiming the duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never names a single Urgot ability outside the word 'Disdain' and never states its cooldown, so 'track Disdain' is advice with no number attached. Urgot's shred is Purge (W), not 'his W'.
audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and shields Urgot while it travels; it is his only gap-closer and, once spent, he is a 490-range Purge platform with no way to leave Twisted Advance's root. Nature's Grasp is terrain and stops the charge outright.
